pr_title: Testar o módulo SQLite outbox em GitHub Actions
pr_body: Executa os testes de regressão do módulo isolado em Python 3.12 no runner Ubuntu.
diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.github/workflows/sync-outbox-ci.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,25 @@
+name: SQLite Outbox Offline Regression
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    branches: [main]
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+jobs:
+  test:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
+    timeout-minutes: 5
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout PR code without persisted credentials
+        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+          submodules: false
+      - name: Run SQLite outbox tests
+        env:
+          PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: "1"
+        run: python3.12 -B -m unittest -v tests.unit.test_sync_outbox
